lines.text: Not GPUs. Not cooling. Not construction.
Nscale's Loughton campus needs up to ninety megawatts. Reportedly, the grid can't supply it until the twenty-thirties.
Designed. Built. Mechanically complete. And still not energised.
So treat utility energisation as a formal commissioning milestone. Everything downstream waits on permanent power.
Staged energisation. Onsite generation. Flexible power architecture.
